title: send --stdin-json input
description: One JSON object of one of two shapes, told apart by keys alone: a hook payload (the keys tool and hook are both strings) or a channel notice (only title, message, level and link, with message present). Anything else is exit 20 payload_unrecognized. The reader is strict beyond what a schema expresses: complete within 5 seconds of the start of the command when read from stdin, at most 1048576 bytes, valid UTF-8, no BOM, no duplicate keys at any depth (compared after unescaping), no NaN or Infinity, no integer outside the signed 64-bit range, nesting depth at most 16 (the top-level object is depth 1); a lone surrogate in a string becomes U+FFFD.
